aliases: 宋故龙骧将军护镇蛮校尉宁州刺史邛都县侯爨使君之碑

attribution.name: 未署名
attribution.note: The cited provincial page records the inscription and its titles but names no writer or calligrapher, so this record asserts no hand.
attribution.noteZh: 所引省级页面记载碑文与题衔，但未记撰文者或书丹者，故不主张作者。

compositionDate.eraLabel: 南朝宋孝武帝大明二年

background: 刻于南朝宋大明二年（458），立于宁州（今云南陆良一带），碑体高大，碑阳正文二十四行，碑阴列职官题名。1961 年与爨宝子碑同列首批全国重点文物保护单位，二者合称「二爨」，是研究南朝边疆与隶楷之变的重要实物。

review.note: Draft record. Date, dimensions and character counts come from the provincial culture department page read on 2026-11-18; the stone was not examined and its present shelter was not confirmed.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录。年代、尺寸与字数取自 2026-11-18 阅读的省文旅厅页面；未核对原石，也未确认现有保护建筑。

notes: The provincial page gives a total height of 3.38 m, widths of 1.35 m at the top and 1.46 m at the bottom, and 1217 characters across the two faces.
Later literature names 爨道庆 as the writer; the cited pages do not, so this record does not assert it.
notesZh: 省文旅厅页面记通高 3.38 米，上宽 1.35 米、下宽 1.46 米，两面合计 1217 字。
后世文献称爨道庆撰文，所引页面未载，故本记录不主张此说。
